Fig. 3
Nutritional interventions affect different mediators in sarcopenic muscle. Recent ﬁndings suggest that the myostatin-Smad pathway inhibits
protein synthesis probably due to blocking the functional role of Akt. Treatment with an ursolic acid upregulates the amount of IGF-I and then
stimulates protein synthesis by activating the Akt/mTORC1/p70S6K pathway. Administration of omega-3 PUFA or HMB may work to prevent
